queue.title: Approvals
queue.intro: Requests waiting for your decision. Open one to see it in full, with its history.
queue.empty: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
queue.sentPublic: Sent from the Request an account form on {date}
queue.someone: someone no longer on the system

detail.historyIntro: Every time this was sent for approval, oldest first.
detail.emailHasLogin: This email address already has a login. Approving will be refused: reject the request, and tell them to sign in or reset their password.

actions.notSignedIn: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again, then decide.
actions.invalid: That decision could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
actions.not_pending: This request has already been decided.
actions.comment_required: Write a comment: say what needs to change, or why it is not approved.
actions.decision_not_allowed: This kind of request cannot take that decision.
actions.already_pending: This is already waiting for a decision.
actions.failed: The decision could not be saved. Try again.
actions.accountNoChanges: An account request is approved or rejected; there is nothing to send back. Reject it with the reason.
actions.accountApproved: Approved. A login was created for {email}.
actions.emailTaken: {email} already has a login, so no new one was made. Reject the request and tell them to sign in, or reset their password on the Users page.
actions.schoolMissing: The school this teacher asked for no longer exists, so her teacher record cannot be made. Reject the request and ask her to apply again.
actions.loginFailed: The login could not be created ({detail}). Nothing was created.
actions.loginLeftBehind: The login could not be created ({detail}). Part of an account for {email} may remain: check the Users page.

decision.commentHint: Needed to request changes or reject. The sender sees it.
decision.commentHintChanges: Needed to request changes. The sender sees it.
decision.passwordHint: Give it to them now, in person or by phone. It is shown only this once and is not stored anywhere. They will be asked to choose their own password when they first sign in. If it is lost, set a new one on the Users page.
